_about: Roblox places' Lighting as the 3D lane's lookdev reads it (kit/blender/rbx_lookdev.py; the 3D crafts plan S0, board card macm). Values as Roblox shows them (colours 0-255, Roblox axes: Y up, -Z front). Each preset says where it was read; anything not measured is named in 'assumed'.

Default.source: a typical Roblox daylight place's Lighting, read in Roblox Studio through the Studio MCP (Lighting properties, GetSunDirection, GetMoonDirection)
Default.not_carried: the Atmosphere (Density 0.27, Offset 0.12, Colour 78,88,120, Haze 1.6), Bloom (Intensity 0.85, Size 30, Threshold 0.92), the colour grade 'DMCGrade' (Contrast 0.2, Saturation 0.08), SunRays, DepthOfField and the skybox
Default.assumed: the light's strength per unit of Brightness (SUN_PER_BRIGHTNESS) and the moon's share of it (MOON_SHARE) in rbx_lookdev.py: not measured against Studio yet; the owner's eye calibrates them

_day.about: a daytime variant of a preset: the same place, its light from a midday sun at DAY_ELEVATION degrees instead of its own clock (not measured: Roblox's sun direction at another clock was not read, to leave the owner's place untouched)

_calibration.about: the Roblox-look rig fitted to Roblox Studio (kit/tools/studio_calibrate.py): a grey sphere (kit/studio/calib_sphere.py) shot in a kit scratch place under each Lighting state, the same sphere rendered in Blender, these numbers solved; rbx_lookdev.calibrated_rig + roblox_view use them
_calibration.not_measured: the day variant's sun height, ColorShift_Bottom, specular, a place's own Sky (the sky term is Roblox's DEFAULT sky's, by day and at night), Atmosphere, bloom and colour grading
